def execute_command(image) -> List[ImagePatch]:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    pedestrian_patches = image_patch.find("pedestrian")
    sidewalk_patches = image_patch.find("sidewalk")
    road_patches = image_patch.find("road")

    if not pedestrian_patches:
        return []

    pedestrian_on_sidewalk = [p for p in pedestrian_patches if any(s.overlaps_with(*p.bbox()) for s in sidewalk_patches)]
    pedestrian_on_road = [p for p in pedestrian_patches if any(r.overlaps_with(*p.bbox()) for r in road_patches)]

    return pedestrian_on_sidewalk + pedestrian_on_road
